title: Test fusion of FP8 scale packing
objective: Test whether fusing a measured scale-layout conversion into one FP8 GEMM removes real production work.
preconditions: The production trace shows scale packing or transformation inside the timed containing region
The baseline contract uses packed int32 UE8M0 scales
steps: Implement one fusion that emits or consumes the production packed layout
Compare against the exact packed production path, not an f32-scale surrogate
Run adversarial scale-boundary correctness and region promotion

acceptance.pass: Kernel count or bytes fall and the containing region wins.
acceptance.no_win: Packing was outside the region or fusion overhead consumes the saving.
acceptance.invalid: The baseline is an unpacked/f32 strawman.

stop_rule: Do not claim removal of work that production had already removed.
origin_evidence: q_b_decode achieved about 1.24x by removing a real scale-packing portion; many apparent 1.5x results only reproduced production packing.
